correctness.rationale: Verjovsky proves that the harmonic energy descends properly to the cyclic quotient, that its critical points are exactly Hopf-differential zeros, and that its minimum equals the least fiber area. The pseudo-Anosov cyclic action on contractible Teichmuller space is free and properly discontinuous, so the quotient is a \(K(\mathbb Z,1)\) with nonzero first homology. Under the explicit Morse hypothesis, the weak Morse inequality forces an index-one critical point. Its negative Hessian direction excludes a global minimum, while zero Hopf differential makes the harmonic representative a nonconstant branched minimal immersion. No finite computation is used in place of this proof.
